events.body:
## Context

`src/handlers/hunts.py` (131 lines) has no tests. This is a narrow slice of the broader Phase I test pass in #3; link that issue in your PR.

## What to do

1. Add `tests/test_hunts.py`, following the mocking style in `tests/test_hackathons.py`.
2. Cover invalid id (400), not found (404), the active/previous/upcoming filters and the pagination maths.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The cases above are covered
- [ ] Passes in CI

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-api
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
